name: Advice context
purpose: Render the active profile's advice — the instance's regulator/advice/<profile>.md — into the unit's system prompt from the file on each session, as the profiles extension's section beside the grant, byte for byte as the profile's inline advice[] rendered before the advice became a file. The advice a unit is told is a file a person can read, a proposal can target by path, and `advice accept` can write; it is not a field inside the grant and it never lives in the transcript. Mirrors identity-context for the second seeded file set.

absorbs.description: What a unit of a profile is told lives inside the same JSON file as the profile's tools and writable paths, so nobody can change the advice without being able to change the grant, a proposal against the advice has no file to name, and a reader cannot see what a unit was told without reading the grant.

enforcementPoints.note: read regulator/advice/<profile>.md from the working tree the unit sees, and the budget policy's advice.maxChars; the status line says what is cut
section regulator_profile: the grant, then the advice file cut at advice.maxChars; one warning per session when it is cut

cost.description: The advice file's length in every prompt of the profile, capped at the budget policy's `advice.maxChars` (4000 characters by default, about 1000 tokens); Pi diffs sections, so unchanged advice is a cache hit.

may: render the profile's advice as a prompt section
say in the status line and once per session that the advice was cut
mayNot: make advice binding (the gate, the bash watch and the closeout check do)
render a grant the profile does not declare

limitations: Level 5 by design: what is rendered is advice. A model can ignore it; what keeps the file what a person decided is the write gate (identity-write-gate), the bash watch and the identity-untouched check.

The advice rendered is the worktree's copy, which a unit's shell can change before the session reads it; the closeout check compares the branch to the base, so a changed copy is a failing check, not changed advice.

Rendering is cut at the budget policy's `advice.maxChars` (4000 characters unless the policy says otherwise); a file longer than that is partly advice the model never sees. The cut is reported — `regulator check` and `regulator doctor` warn with the size, the limit and the file, the session's status line says so and the session warns once — and refuses nothing: shortening the file is a person's decision (docs/DEBT.md row 45).

Outside an instance that carries the file (a session run by hand in a plain checkout, or an instance initialized before advice was a file set) the grant alone renders, or the inline advice a profile still carries during the one release of overlap; nothing says the unit was told less than the definition intends.

ablation.note: Shares the profiles extension with the profile write grant: an arm without it renders no advice and grants nothing by profile either. The drift suite's control arm runs without identity and the host checks, not without profiles; a per-profile advice override on an arm is slice 3 of the accept-path split.

retirement.condition: Retire the rendered section when the drift suite shows no conformance loss across three model versions with the section off and the gates on: the grant and the contract carry the unit alone.
